newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss chemical exports rise 4.5 pct Jan-Sept.
newsitem.headline: Swiss chemical exports rise 4.5 pct Jan-Sept.

text.p: Exports from Switzerland's chemical industry rose 4.5 percent in the first nine months of the year from the same 1995 period to a value of 19.1 billion Swiss francs, the Swiss Society of Chemical Industries (SSIC) said.
SSIC said in a statement imports rose 4.6 percent to 10 billion francs during the same period, resulting in an export surplus of 9.1 billion francs.
Chemical exports to Europe rose 3.3 percent to 12.37 billion francs with exports to eastern Europe rising 20.1 percent to 769 million.
Exports to the Americas rose 14.6 percent to 3.08 billion francs with the rise to the U.S. amounting to 15.6 percent to 1.64 billion.
Exports to Asia rose 1.3 percent to 2.94 billion francs.
